title: Compile an authored semantic score to exact MIDI
summary: GF-style local build: validates a bounded monophonic score and serializes MIDI with reproducible note/timing/hash receipts. CI validates compiler behavior only; not Suno conditioning, artistic intent or listener preference.

build.target: Export a validated original monophonic melody as reproducible Standard MIDI with a source-to-events receipt.
requires: mido for final MIDI serialization; included script and original score JSON
inputs: Explicit score JSON with pitches, timing, rests and constraints
outputs: SHA-256 source/output receipt and note/timing summary
execute: Read the package-local skills/semantic-midi/build.json and SKILL.md.
Run compile_melody.py with --validate-only to reject malformed score.
Compile with --output to a new .mid path.
Use an independent MIDI reader to confirm note count, pitches, exact ticks and tempo.
Record the two hashes and do not claim any Suno-generated fidelity.

applies_when: An original monophonic hook needs an exact MIDI artifact.
A machine has authored explicit notes; musical choices are already resolved.
avoid_when: The score is polyphonic, chromatic, over 16 bars or otherwise beyond the v0 contract.
The user only specified abstract mood; no note events have been authored.

enforced: Score 64KiB, 1–16 bars, 1–128 notes, exact beat fractions and validated pitch register
operator: The helper refuses overwriting different existing files.
No provider upload, credit spending or account authority.

stop_when: MIDI export and round-trip receipt match expected events.
Invalid score ends in a bounded clear error without auto-correction.

checks: Verify 13-note original fixture read-back and deterministic bytes.
A passing local CI test does not verify Suno or listener experience.
